admission_scope: Exactly one fixed 30-epoch final-checkpoint development fit; no navigation or physical deployment admission.

resolved_findings.issue: Per-height denominators were absent from scorer.
resolved_findings.fix: Scorer now reports per-height predictions, truth, precision, recall and absent_truth; absent-truth recall is null.

resolved_findings.issue: Fit admission did not bind reviewed code and sanitized inference identity.
resolved_findings.fix: Runner checks coverage source/dataset hashes, review hashes and sanitized inference manifests before exclusive fit receipt.
Scorer verifies sealed source/checkpoint and coverage dataset hashes before scoring.

evidence.static_input_review: Network input is only current paired RGB and native gravity; GT depth/pose/joints only create supervision. No SGBM, GT pose, map history, time or layout ID network argument.
evidence.native_pose_identity: All 543 known-pose rotations reconstructed and matched same-clock native_predictions with available/live flags.
evidence.calibration: All 1086 actual optical-to-base extrinsics match forward .4 m, lateral +/- .3 m, up .05 m and declared optical rotation.
evidence.target_geometry: Depth is distance_to_image_plane; unprojection signs and yaw rotation correct. Four global-yaw invariance fixtures passed. Three datasets passed shapes/dtypes/finite gravity/time monotonicity checks.
evidence.sanitized_inputs: All three sanitized RGB/gravity archives are bytewise-array equal to their dataset fields and contain no labels.
evidence.metric_fixtures: Exact prediction passes; all unknown fails; absent top height recall null.
evidence.split: Entire H/E2 and E0 fit; entire E1 excluded. Three distinct source scene identities; exact paired-RGB overlap with E1 zero.
evidence.fit_guard: Exclusive fit_started.json creation, fixed seed2026/30epochs/batch16/Adam .001, final checkpoint only; no E1 optimizer/loss/normalization.

limitations: E1 is researcher-seen development data and supplies no fresh independent generalization evidence.
E1 has zero true top-height-band cells; aggregate source admission does not validate all height bands.

Gravity determines heading-aligned tilt; no absolute yaw network input is needed because target is globally yaw invariant. Horizontal body-forward norms exceed .982 here; vertical heading singularity is outside tested data.
GT local target yaw differs from native yaw used for eventual global registration. End-to-end pose/map error is not evaluated by these local source metrics.
The class per cell is the highest supported visible height band; overlapping lower bands are not retained. Ground is an observed surface, never free-space certification.
CAD mask, finite .5-3 m axial depth, root exclusion and fixed height range define the qualified visible target; hidden surfaces, excluded heights and unlabelled cells remain unknown.
Native gravity is estimated from causal IMU history with privileged initial gauge and fixed calibration; it is not an independently calibrated real sensor evaluation.
